messages:
Jules (CS): Dropping a concise go-live cheat map for small-mid customers. Focus: prefill cadence, tiny batch windows, streaming fallback, and a short renewal-signal capture plan. Will paste config + checks below.
Arman (SE): love it. quick ask: can we include a sample traffic JSON that customers can export for load sizing?
Jules (CS): yes. sample and a 1-line rationale for each field included.
Priya (Eng): engineering notes: prefer soft progressive prefill (smooth ramp) + staggered jitter to avoid thundering herd. KV-cache TTL 10m for common prefixes. Recommend warm-pool of 27 GPUs for the first 24 hours post-go-live for medium accounts.
Jules (CS): minimal client config to share with SEs/customers:
```json
{"prefill":true,"prefill_mode":"soft_progressive","prefill_seconds":25,"batch_window_ms":35,"max_batch_tokens":200,"stream":true,"client_heartbeat_s":25}
```
Rina (CS): adding the 48h pulse survey we use: 3 questions (accuracy likert, latency ok Y/N, any hallucination examples?). capture in ticket and tag renewal_risk if negative.
Noah (PM): propose a tiny risk-mapping table in playbook: green = normal (no action), amber = monitor (CS 72h check-in), red = immediate outreach + escalation. Signals: usage drop >40%, p95 latency >1.5x expected, eval fail count >2.
Arman (SE): troubleshooting checklist (pasteable):
```bash
# check stream connectivity
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/check?model=mdl123
# verify x-request-id in logs
rg "x-request-id:" /var/log/redwood/*
```
Priya (Eng): fallback policy suggestion: if automated evals show >2 regressions in 1h, route traffic to stable variant for 10min and trigger alert. Also enable temporary increase in batch_window to preserve latency under load.
Jules (CS): customer handoff checklist bullets: sample prompt set, expected p95 latency, peak QPS, sample traffic JSON, contact for oncall + CS 72h check-in.
Arman (SE): sample traffic JSON for SRE handoff:
```json
{"peak_qps":8,"avg_tokens":60,"interactive":true,"median_session_s":95}
```
Infra-bot: Notice: will run warm-pool prewarm job on onboarding tag "warm-start" tomorrow 04:00 UTC.
Rina (CS): I'll schedule the 48h survey in the welcome email and set up the 72h CS check-in rule for accounts in the "amber" bucket.
Noah (PM): let's run a 15m sync Wed to review the playbook language and SLA wording. Great quick doc, Jules.
Jules (CS): thanks all. I'll publish as "Go-live Ops Quickmap" and attach the one-pager in the playbook. Closing thread and moving checklist to the doc. /end
